Card Q&A.q: Is it true that both the Digimon card and the Tamer card must have the [Xros Heart] trait in order for this card's effect to be able to add them to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reveals 3 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a Digimon card or a Tamer card with the [Xros Heart] trait, can I still add a card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: This card's effect reveals 3 cards. If both Digimon and Tamer cards with the [Xros Heart] trait are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card and 1 Tamer card―both with [Xros Heart] in their traits―among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Shoutmon] in its name, it gains ＜Rush＞. (This Digimon may attack the turn it was played.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] 0 from Lv.2 w/[Xros Heart] in traits
